# Meta CDN (fbcdn.net)
> Content delivery domain used by Meta to serve static assets, media, and supporting resources for Facebook, Instagram, and related products.

fbcdn.net is primarily a CDN and asset-hosting domain rather than a standalone documentation site. Useful LLM context comes from Meta’s official developer, engineering, privacy, and help resources that explain the products and APIs whose assets are commonly delivered through this domain.

## Meta for Developers
- [Meta for Developers](https://developers.facebook.com/): Main developer portal for Meta platforms, products, tools, and documentation.
- [Documentation](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/): Central index for Meta developer documentation across products and APIs.
- [Graph API](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/graph-api/): Reference and guides for Meta’s core social graph API.
- [Marketing API](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-apis/): Documentation for ads management, insights, and campaign automation APIs.
- [Webhooks](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/graph-api/webhooks/): Guides for subscribing to and receiving real-time platform updates.
- [App Development](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/development/): Core concepts for building, configuring, and managing Meta apps.

## Facebook Platform
- [Facebook Login](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/facebook-login/): Authentication flows and permissions for signing users in with Facebook.
- [Sharing](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/sharing/): Tools and integrations for sharing content to Facebook surfaces.
- [Social Plugins](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/plugins/): Embeddable plugins such as Like, Share, and Page widgets.
- [Pages API](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/pages-api/): Access and management capabilities for Facebook Pages.
- [Messenger Platform](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/messenger-platform/): APIs and guides for building Messenger experiences and bots.
- [Video API](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/video-api/): Uploading, managing, and publishing video on Facebook.

## Instagram Platform
- [Instagram Platform Overview](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/instagram-platform/): Overview of Instagram APIs, use cases, and platform capabilities.
- [Instagram Graph API](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/instagram-platform/instagram-graph-api/): Business and creator account access for publishing and insights.
- [Instagram Basic Display API](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/instagram-basic-display-api/): Read-only access to basic Instagram profile and media data.
- [Content Publishing](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/instagram-platform/content-publishing/): Publishing workflows for Instagram business content.
- [Webhooks](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/instagram-platform/webhooks/): Real-time notifications for Instagram account activity.
- [Insights](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/instagram-platform/insights/): Metrics and analytics for Instagram business accounts.

## WhatsApp Business Platform
- [WhatsApp Business Platform](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/): Official documentation for WhatsApp business messaging APIs and setup.
- [Cloud API](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/cloud-api/): Hosted WhatsApp API for sending messages and managing conversations.
- [On-Premises API](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/on-premises/): Self-hosted WhatsApp Business API deployment and operations guidance.
- [Guides](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/guides/): Task-oriented guides for onboarding, messaging, and templates.
- [Reference](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/cloud-api/reference/): Endpoint and object reference for WhatsApp Cloud API.
- [Webhooks](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/whatsapp/cloud-api/webhooks/): Event delivery setup for inbound messages and status updates.

## Business and Ads
- [Marketing APIs](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-apis/): Programmatic access to ads, audiences, creatives, and reporting.
- [Ads Insights API](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/insights/): Query ad performance metrics and reporting dimensions.
- [Conversions API](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/conversions-api/): Server-side event measurement for ads optimization and attribution.
- [Business Management](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/businessmanager/): Manage businesses, assets, permissions, and system users.
- [Catalog API](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/catalog/): Commerce catalog management for products and inventory.
- [System Users](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/marketing-api/system-users/): Create and manage system users for business integrations.

## SDKs and Tools
- [SDKs](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/): Documentation hub linking official SDKs and platform tools.
- [Android SDK](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/android/): Native Android integration for Facebook platform features.
- [iOS SDK](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/ios/): Native iOS integration for login, sharing, and app events.
- [JavaScript SDK](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/javascript/): Browser SDK for login, dialogs, and social integrations.
- [App Dashboard](https://developers.facebook.com/apps/): Console for creating apps and configuring Meta platform products.
- [Graph API Explorer](https://developers.facebook.com/tools/explorer/): Interactive tool for testing Graph API requests.

## Help and Support
- [Meta Business Help Center](https://www.facebook.com/business/help): Help articles for business tools, ads, and account management.
- [Facebook Help Center](https://www.facebook.com/help/): End-user help documentation for Facebook features and settings.
- [Instagram Help Center](https://help.instagram.com/): Support articles for Instagram accounts, privacy, and product features.
- [WhatsApp Help Center](https://faq.whatsapp.com/): Official support documentation for WhatsApp products and usage.
- [Developer Support](https://developers.facebook.com/support/): Support entry points for app review, technical issues, and platform questions.
- [Platform Status](https://metastatus.com/): Service status and incident information for Meta developer and business systems.

## Policies and Privacy
- [Platform Terms](https://developers.facebook.com/terms/): Terms governing use of Meta developer products and platform access.
- [Developer Policies](https://developers.facebook.com/policy/): Rules and compliance requirements for Meta app developers.
- [Meta Privacy Policy](https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy/): Privacy policy covering Meta products and data handling practices.
- [Platform Policy 4](https://developers.facebook.com/policy/#platform-terms): Policy and platform requirements reference for developers.
- [Data Processing Terms](https://www.facebook.com/legal/terms/dataprocessing): Legal terms for data processing in business and developer contexts.
- [Cookies Policy](https://www.facebook.com/policies/cookies/): Information about cookies and related technologies across Meta services.

## Engineering and Technical Context
- [Meta Engineering](https://engineering.fb.com/): Engineering articles about infrastructure, systems, and product architecture at Meta.
- [Open Source at Meta](https://opensource.fb.com/): Meta-maintained open source projects, tools, and engineering resources.
- [Research at Meta](https://research.facebook.com/): Research publications and technical work across AI and systems domains.
- [AI at Meta](https://ai.meta.com/): Applied AI research, models, and technical initiatives from Meta.
- [Security](https://www.facebook.com/security/): Security guidance, programs, and account protection information.
- [Bug Bounty](https://www.facebook.com/whitehat/): Security vulnerability disclosure and bounty program details.
